naive_touch.interpretation: counterfactual standalone orders; not portfolio PnL

cancel_ahead.interpretation: counterfactual standalone orders; not portfolio PnL

conservative.interpretation: counterfactual standalone orders; not portfolio PnL

evaluation.purge: train labels must mature inside train period
evaluation.queue_models: naive touch is intentionally unrealistic; conservative ignores cancels; cancel-ahead assumes all cancels ahead

limitations: No market impact, risk limits, latency measured in events rather than nanoseconds, exchange-specific fee schedule, or production-calibrated execution.
LOBSTER free sample is historical and one day only: time split is not an out-of-day validation.
Visible executions have order-side direction, not aggressor side.
Displayed market-by-price depth cannot reveal exact FIFO position; cancellation ahead is uncertain.
Hypothetical orders are independent counterfactuals; conditional markouts are not a tradable strategy PnL or Sharpe.
Synthetic demonstrations are controlled unit evidence only, never evidence of financial alpha.
Circular-shift null reuses autocorrelated observations; empirical p-value is a rough sensitivity check, not a rigorous significance guarantee.
